subject: [hw] T02 -> IV: fake hardware API, script grammar and record format (available next hour)
body:
tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c will implement n2vc_hw_open_fake() from include/n2vc_hw.h. Because the frozen header has no script argument, I add tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.h (my file) with:
  int n2vc_hw_fake_script(struct n2vc_hw *h, const char *path);   // load/replace rules; 0 or -EINVAL
  unsigned n2vc_hw_fake_violations(const struct n2vc_hw *h);      // accesses to unpowered windows
  void n2vc_hw_fake_stats(const struct n2vc_hw *h, struct n2vc_hw_fake_stats *out);
  int n2vc_hw_fake_set_poll_timeout(struct n2vc_hw *h, uint32_t us); // default 100 ms; the n2vc_hw regs() callback has no poll_timeout field
  int n2vc_hw_fake_dma_host(struct n2vc_hw *h, uint32_t handle, void **p, uint32_t *bytes);
open_fake also loads $N2VC_FAKE_SCRIPT if set, so a test can do: setenv, open, run.
Script lines (literal, one rule per line, # comments):
  after write VENC 0x0010 0x00000001&0x0000000f -> set VENC 0x0014 0x00000002
  irq 0 fires 5 ms after write VENC 0x0030 0x00000001
  read VENC 0x0020 returns 0x12345678 [once]
Window names are the RWVC_WIN_* names (VENC, VENC_C1, VDEC_SYS, ...). Masked-write trigger value is value&mask. Rules chain, bounded at depth 32 (-ELOOP + violation). Power blocks: VENC_C1 implies VEN, VDEC_CORE implies VDEC_SOC (hidden refs, as K02).
Recorder lines (one per op, flushed):
  POWER VENC on -> 0
  W VENC 0x0010 0x00000001
  W VENC 0x0010 0x00000003 mask 0x0000000f
  R VENC 0x0010 0x00000001
  POLL VENC 0x0010 0x00000001 mask 0x00000001 -> ok reads=1
  DELAY 100 us
  IRQ wait 0 timeout_ms=100 -> 0 status=0x00000001
  DMA alloc handle=1 pa=0xda800000 bytes=4096 flags=0
DMA: first-fit pages in RW_CLAIM_VCODEC, zero-filled, handles global, dma_rw is a plain copy. If you need a different record token or a script form, tell me now; I keep the grammar stable after DONE.
